title: 14,000 UFO sightings in Germany: reporting centre in Hesse investigates
description: Glowing spheres and mysterious lights are generating a wave of reports in Germany. As Pentagon files reignite debate, CENAP in Lützelbach has long sought to explain the sightings.

title: UFO files: Watch appears to jump 25 minutes ahead after encounter
100-foot triangular UFO ‘captured in video’
description: A pair of classified videos allegedly showing a 100-foot (30-metre) black triangular UFO over a Colorado military base remain locked away despite President Donald Trump’s new order aimed at encouraging more UFO whistleblowers to come forward, sources familiar with the footage told The Post.

title: UFO files claim 'dead spaceman' found inside mysterious metal sphere after it crashed to Earth
description: US government officials launched an investigation into bizarre claims that a 'dead spaceman' was found inside a metal sphere that fell to Earth in Brazil, the latest UFO files reveal

title: UFO over Colorado military base? Two alleged videos remain classified despite Trump’s disclosure order
description: The alleged Colorado videos are therefore significant primarily as an example of the evidence whistleblowers say exists but cannot publicly disclose. Until the footage is released and independently examined, the claims about the object shown in the videos cannot be verified.
